lessons: Assumes she follows through best in the early-evening window after 18:30, which is flagged as habitual behaviour, social opportunity and suitable for outdoor. Midday windows with physical opportunity suit short walks. Low-effort admin and planning tasks fit short morning gaps. Long tasks need long free blocks and are kept away from the busiest days. With about zero workouts a week as her goal, intense tasks are limited to one or two spread-out evening slots.
